content.text:
Saved sketch to `/tmp/wheel-state-astra.md`.

Recommend required `selected: Id | null`, with page state initialized to `null`. A tagged union adds no useful invariant for these two states.

Guard the entire results board until selection, preserving the requested initial subtitle. Move accent fill to the base sector rule; selected styling becomes an accent rim. Remove tick markup/CSS, retain independent neutral keyboard focus and native buttons.

Existing gallery selections remain compatible. Backend semantics, preloading, financial labels, and category colors remain unchanged.
